item.title: Gulls Remain Undefeated Over Roadrunners with Overtime Win
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls defeated the Tucson Roadrunners in overtime tonight at Tucson Convention Center, 3-2. San Diego now remains undefeated over Tucson this season, going 3-0-0-0. Nikita Nesterenko found the game-winning goal just 1:25 into overtime. The goal marks Nesterenko’s first AHL goal of the season since returning to the Gulls on Jan. 15. Defenseman Nikolas Brouillard tallied an assist on the goal, giving him 11 total this season. item.title: San Diego Gulls Assign Vyacheslav Buteyets to Tulsa
item.description: The San Diego Gulls announced today that the American Hockey League (AHL) club has assigned goaltender Vyacheslav Buteyets to the Tulsa Oilers (ECHL). Buteyets, 23 (5/29/02), has combined for an 9-11-0 record in 21 appearances this season with San Diego and Tulsa. He is 1-3-0 with the Gulls this season. item.title: Gulls Sweep Roadrunners in Back-to-Back Series
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls remain undefeated against the Tucson Roadrunners as they swept the series tonight with a win at Tucson Convention Center, 5-3. item.title: Gulls Shutout by Canucks
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the Abbotsford Canucks at Rogers Forum today, 4-0. San Diego put up 30 shots in attempt to get on the board but could not find a way through. The team had another successful night of penalty killing, going 2-for-2 which brings their overall percentage to 85.2%. The power play still proved to be a struggle as the Gulls went 0-for-2. item.title: Gulls Drop to Tucson in Shootout
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the Tucson Roadrunners in a shootout tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 4-3. San Diego took a 3-0 lead early before Tucson responded with three themselves to tie the game up. After a scoreless third period and overtime, the game was sent to a shootout which went on to be the Gulls longest of the season so far with 10 shooters.
